manifest.description: Host-only reproduction of nine primary 3m controls, old payload seed; not fresh campaign results

scoring_rule: All listed non-excluded windows, no CRC/error/weak-fit filtering. TX frame_hex is 48 bits MSB first. Reuse eval_controls/export_dataset bits_hex, replay_input, decision_bytes and train_eval.tflite_predict/ci/metric. Classic bits used directly; no preamble polarity flip or truth-selected inversion. Host probabilities use model output scale/zero-point and >=0.5; AUG INT8 >=0 maps to 1 (scale 1/256, zero -128). Exact two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson; pooled bits/windows may be correlated. Capture CPU/NPU values are ORIGINAL CNN and never used as AUG. 30 FPS acquisition, 20 Hz resampling, 5 bit/s link.
